title: Applicant Landlord: Geraldine Kennedy – Respondent Tenant: Beatriz Valero, James O’Neill
text:
Residential Tenancies Board

Determination Order

Ref: DR1117-38551

In the matter of Valerie Holland [Applicant Landlord] and Dmitri Usatii, Svetlana Usatii
[Respondent Tenants] the Residential Tenancies Board, in accordance with section 121 of
the Residential Tenancies Act 2004, determines that:

The parties reached an agreement in relation to the dispute, the terms of which are
attached hereto. The Adjudicator makes an Order as per the Terms and Conditions of the
said agreement, a copy of which is annexed hereto and forms part of this Order, in
respect of the tenancy of the dwelling at 104 Marsham Court, Stillorgan, Dublin.

This Order was made by the Residential Tenancies Board on 19 January 2018.
